summary: Founder Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of Class B shares as special discretionary bonuses to two directors. On June 11, 2026, the board approved a $60,000 bonus to CEO/Chairman Lee Seng Chi satisfied by 30,000 Class B shares, and a $40,000 bonus to director Thien Chiet Chai satisfied by 20,000 Class B shares. The bonuses were granted for past contributions. No shareholder vote or external advisor was mentioned. This is a routine equity compensation event, not a special situation.
